Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciate the open discussion about your compliance gating items. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement moving: 

- Ask: MedLineOps has asked for a SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) or a temporary attestation/bridge if the full report timing is delayed. They also want access to a secure evidence portal (trust portal) for any supporting artifacts.
- Scope notes: you mentioned GDPR and HIPAA requirements for PHI handling — our SOC 2 scope covers data processing for inference requests; happy to share the specific data-processing addendum language if helpful.
- Vendor questionnaire: to speed the intake, I’ve attached our vendor DDQ template (blank) — please share any pre-filled sections you want us to review.

Proposed timeline:
1) If possible, please confirm the internal security contact who will accept portal invites (name + email) — we can typically provision Trust Portal access within 48 hours once we have the right contact.
2) If SOC 2 Type II has sensitive sections, we can provide a redacted report and a short temporary attestation (bridge) while we coordinate with our auditor.
3) If portal access is delayed, we can provision SFTP or a direct secure link as a fallback for artifacts.

Next steps I’ll take: I’ll loop in Jordan to handle the trust portal invite and Ben on the artifacts/attestation side. Jordan — can you confirm typical lead times for portal invites and whether we should pre-provision an SFTP fallback?

Elena — would you prefer the portal invite go to security@medlineops.com or a named contact?

Thanks,
